# GitHub Copilot

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root before you do anything here. It is the only place the rules are written. In short:

- Everything here is made up. Never add real requirements, exports, programme names or personal details, anywhere, including commit messages.
- Do not push, publish, or change a remote, a secret or a CI setting unless the owner says so in this conversation.
- Say what you did not check. Do not claim more than a check shows.
